sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Arrived on site and debriefing with morning shift.
Ippondo called in regards to vagrants outside their store.
Removed the vagrants. (video on file) Standing by for security presence.
Heading to Aotea Square while doing welfare checks on businesses.
Welfare checks completed from Ippondo to Burger Fuel Queen Street. All clear. Commencing sweep of the area.
Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Coco Tea on High Street in regards to a vagrant disturbing customers.
Vagrant left and we tried to talk to the poi but he was not responding. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Movenpick about an elderly female who seems to be under the influence and may have dementia.

Arrived at Movenpick Hotel and spoke to the elderly female. She was under the influence and may have dementia, or the memory loss may be due to the alcohol. The poi name is Vivian Simmons. The receptionist from Movenpick Hotel called due to her refusing to leave, so we tried to see if we could help. She mumbled a lot and was repeating questions and sentences a lot. We were able to flag down police and they assisted us. We tried getting in contact with her husband Laurence Simmons but to no avail; thankfully the police were able to, after Vivian refused a police ride home, so the husband was on his way to pick her up. He came and took her. Now standing by for security presence. (video on file)
Heading to a call from Celine.
Removed the vagrants smoking next to Celine. (photo on file)
Heading to Queen Street McDonald's regarding people smoking weed next to the entrance.
Vagrants have left. (photo on file) Standing by for security presence.
Standing by outside Lovisa; all stores from Queen Street McDonald's to Lovisa are all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Stores from Lovisa to Michael Hill all clear. Standing by at Vulcan Lane for security.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart, Q Convenience Store, and Movenpick all clear. Heading to a call from Munster Inn.
We arrived and were told that the male vagrant had left 5 mins ago. Heading to office to do floor checks.
Charging Ops Phone which is on 16%.
High Street and Freyberg Square all clear. Heading to Chancery Square.
Chancery Square full sweep completed. No issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Pocket Park, Fort Street, Fort Lane, Wilson Carpark, Jo & Joe's, Right Track, Vapor King, Vape Haven, KFC, and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Heading to Gore Street.
Gore Street including Auckland Harbour Suites, Giapo, Chargrill, City Liquor, and Smiley Mart is all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Britomart via Customs Street.
Britomart McDonald's all clear. Checking on Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart Convenience Store all clear. Received photos of a poi that had stolen $130 worth of goods, but staff were unaware about informing us. Police were notified. Continuing patrol.
Cathedral area all clear. Heading towards corner of Victoria and Federal Street.
Welfare check on both convenience stores, The Fiddler, News Agency, and Hell's Pizza. No issues, heading towards the office.
Arrived at the office, having break.
Break completed, standing by to charge Ops Phone.
Received a call from Metropolis requesting assistance with removing a trespassed person.
Female poi has been allowed to be on the premises with the fiance present and with her at all times. (video on file) Heading back to the office.
